body:
**One app for several games**
- **Black Myth: Wukong:** pak, UE4SS and C# Loader mods. The C# Loader and UE4SS install with one click, save backups work, and the game starts with `-fileopenlog`, which its pak mods need.
- **Phantom Blade Zero:** everything as before.
- **Stellar Blade: Blood Rain:** a preview of its look, until the game is out. Take a peek and tell us what you think on Discord.
- **Choose your game** at the first start, or any time with **Switch game** in the title bar. Each game has its own look, and its own mods and backups.

**What else is new**
- **Launch options:** the gear on the right of **Launch game** sets the arguments the game starts with, with the game's recommended ones.
- **Tray icon** next to the clock, with a menu to switch or launch the game. **Settings** can minimize and close the app to the tray.
- **Missing your game?** In the game picker, **Scan a game folder** makes a report to share on Discord, with your user name and ids hidden.
- The game picker's cards show where each game is on your PC and how many mods it has.
- At the first start the language question comes first, and the game picker has a language selector.
- The install review names the game the mods go into.
- A UE4SS put in by hand is no longer offered as an update when it is already the newest build.
- A new app icon, the same for every game.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.0.0.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. After the update it asks once for your game: choose **Phantom Blade Zero**, and your mods, sets and backups are all there. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.0.0.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Thanks** to czastack for B1CSharpLoader, which the C# Loader for Black Myth: Wukong is built on.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
